messages:
Alejandra: quick thought — propose adding a lightweight 'macro' to deploy-bot that does: pin version -> run health checks for X minutes -> auto rollforward if green, else leave pin + annotate and page. meh?
Sam: sounds useful. can the watch be based on both latency/error-rate checks and time?
Chris: +1. also need to ensure audit info (who ran it) and TTL on pins so they don't linger.
deploy-bot: prototype hook added to canary: `/deploy macro preview` shows a draft API. currently supports `--pin`, `--watch-mins`, `--on-fail` flags.
Maggie: my main ask is an explicit oncall ACK before any auto-rollforward during change windows. auto actions are cool but we need human gate for risky releases.
Ben: agree with Maggie. default behavior should be conservative: create pin and start checks, but require OK from oncall to actually lift the pin unless a strict opt-in flag is provided.
Alejandra: good point — updated idea: v1 defaults to "require-ok" gating. flow: pin -> run checks -> if green -> send prompt to oncall (1-click approve) OR wait auto-rollforward timeout if opted in by release owner via `--auto-roll` flag.
Sam: edge case: cross-version cache incompatibility. macro should have safety that refuses auto-rollforward if model change type == breaking. maybe detect via model metadata or require `--force` to bypass.
Chris: we should also add a tiny release-note template generated by bot so owners don't forget to call out pin/rollforward behavior. e.g.:
```
Pinned: svc/backend@sha:abcdef
Auto-roll: 10m if health OK
Gate: oncall ack required
```
Maggie: I'll draft the RFC for the gating UX and page flow. I can mock the Slack approval button in the RFC.
Ben: I'll add the health-gating checks (error% threshold, p95 latency) into the preflight suite. Sam, can you help add the cache-compat check?
Sam: yup, I can add a quick metadata comparator and flag incompatible changes. will add `--force` opt.
Alejandra: i'll spin up a minimal PR for the bot macro and the release-note generator tomorrow. plan: canary the command for 24h, collect data, then flip on in staging.
deploy-bot: note recorded: macro feature flagged under `deploy_macro_v1` in canary. use `/deploy macro help` for flags.
Alejandra: :rocket: thanks all — volunteers: Maggie (RFC), Ben (health checks), Sam (cache check), me (bot PR). I'll update this thread with PR link when ready.
